title: The legend of Vishvamitra
introduction: Enquiring about his father Gautama's reuniting with his mother Ahalya, Sage Shataananda relates the legend of Vishvamitra. Shataananda greets Rama for his adherence to the rectitude of Vishvamitra, which Vishvamitra gained through a series of self-important exploits, when he was a great king at one time. Shataananda finds worth in informing the biography of Vishvamitra to Rama, because too much of overbearing of kings, as has been done by Vishvamitra, will be unbecoming for kings.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकपंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 51st chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः |
हृष्टरोमा महातेजाः शतानन्दो महातपाः
गौतमस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभः |
रामसंदर्शनादेव परं विस्मयमागतः
verses.iast:
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ |
hṛṣṭa romā mahātejāḥ śatāanando mahātapāḥ
gautamasya suto jyeṣṭhaḥ tapasā dyotita prabhaḥ |
rāma sandarśanāt eva param vismayam āgataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that sentence of that intellectual sage Vishvamitra, the highly refulgent and the great ascetic Shataananda is overjoyed, and Sage Shataananda, the eldest son of Sage Gautama, and whose radiance is brightened by his own ascesis is highly amazed just on seeing Rama.

glosses.meaning: his, of Vishvamitra, that, sentence, on hearing
by ascesis, brightened, radiance - who has it
Rama, on seeing at, just by

verses.devanagari:
एतौ निषण्णौ संप्रेक्ष्य सुखासीनौ नृपात्मजौ |
शतानन्दो मुनिश्रेष्ठं विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
etau niṣaṇṇau samprekṣya sukha āsīnau nṛpātmajau |
śatāanando muniśreṣṭham viśvāmitram atha abravīt
verses.translation: On raptly observing those two princes who are sitting comfortably with their heads bending down submissively, then Shataananda spoke to the eminent sage Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: the two whose heads are bent - bowing submissively
those two, king's sons [princes,] on raptly observing
to sage, the eminent, to Vishvamitra, spoke.

verses.devanagari:
अपि ते मुनिशार्दूल मम माता यशस्विनी |
दर्शिता राजपुत्राय तपो दीर्घमुपागता
verses.iast:
api te muni śārdūla mama mātā yaśasvinī |
darśitā rāja putrāya tapo dīrgham upāgatā
verses.translation: "Oh, tigerly saint Vishvamitra, you have revealed my glorious mother Ahalya who meted out a marathon ascesis to the princes - Really!

glosses.meaning: marathon, ascesis, came near [who meted out]

verses.devanagari:
अपि रामे महातेजो मम माता यशस्विनी |
वन्यैरुपाहरत् पूजां पूजार्हे सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.iast:
api rāme mahātejo mama mātā yaśasvinī |
vanyaiḥ upāharat pūjām pūjā arhe sarva dehinām
verses.translation: "And the highly resplendent and celebrated mother of mine worshipped Rama, who is worthy of worship by every corporeal being, with forest produce, is it so!

glosses.meaning: highly resplendent one, celebrated one - Ahalya
by every, one with body [with corporeity, corporeal beings]
for deference, worthy of, in Rama - in respect of Rama
with forest produce - flowers and fruits
worship, even, has she performed - has she worshipped him?

verses.devanagari:
अपि रामाय कथितं यद् वृत्तं तत्पुरातनम् |
मम मातुर्महातेजो दैवेन दुरनुष्ठितम्
verses.iast:
api rāmāya kathitam yathā vṛttam purātanam |
mama mātuḥ mahātejo daivena duranuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: "Oh, great-resplendent Vishvamitra, you have narrated to Rama about the maltreatment of my mother by the Providence as has happened anciently, isn't it!

glosses.meaning: by Providence, mal-, treatment - subjected to

verses.devanagari:
अपि कौशिक भद्रं ते गुरुणा मम संगता |
माता मम मुनिश्रेष्ठ रामसंदर्शनादितः
verses.iast:
api kauśika bhadram te guruṇā mama saṅgatā |
mātā mama muniśreṣṭha rāma sandarśanāt itaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, the best sage Kaushika, you be safe, my mother is reunited with my father on beholding and giving hospitality to Rama - Really!

glosses.meaning: Rama's, by bolding - giving hospitality etc

verses.devanagari:
अपि मे गुरुणा रामः पूजितः कुशिकात्मज |
इहागतो महातेजाः पूजां प्राप्य महात्मनः
verses.iast:
api me guruṇā rāmaḥ pūjitaḥ kuśikātmaja |
iha āgato mahātejāḥ pūjām prāpya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaushika, my father came to my mother's place from Himalayas! Has the great resplendent father of mine worshipped Rama because the redemption of my mother is per the kindness of Rama! Has this great-souled Rama reverenced that great resplendent father of mine by according a redemption, ahalyaa daana, the endowment of Ahalya to her husband.

glosses.meaning: by my, father, even, is he worshipped
here [to Ahalya's place,] one who came, great-resplendent one [Gautama, Shataananda's father]

verses.devanagari:
अपि शान्तेन मनसा गुरुर्मे कुशिकात्मज|
इहागतेन रामेण पुजितेनाभिवादितः
verses.iast:
api śāntena manasā guruḥ me kuśikātmaja |
iha āgatena rāmeṇa pūjitena abhivāditaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaushika, on his arrival at my mother's place whether this reverential Rama reverenced my father with a pacified heart without becoming contumelious!" Thus sage Shataananda exclaimed at the marvel occurred through Rama.

glosses.meaning: to here [at Ahalya's place,] who came
by a reverential one - Rama [prayatena = by a pure soul - Rama]

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |
प्रत्युवाच शतानन्दं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यगोविदम्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ |
prati uvāca śatānandam vākyajño vākya kovidam
verses.translation: On hearing that sentence of his, that great-saint and sentence-precisian Sage Vishvamitra, replied the sentence-precisionist Sage Shataananda.

glosses.meaning: sentence-precisian to sentence, to precisionist, to Shataananda

verses.devanagari:
नातिक्रान्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत् कर्तव्यं कृतं मया |
संगता मुनिना पत्नी भार्गवेणेव रेणुका
verses.iast:
na atikrāntam muniśreṣṭha yat kartavyam kṛtam mayā |
saṅgatā muninā patnī bhār.hgaveṇa iva reṇukā
verses.translation: "I have done whatever good is to be done and nothing is left undone, and the wife of the sage, namely Ahalya, is reunited with her husband sage Gautama, as with Renuka who was reunited with sage Jamagani, the descendent of Bhrigu." So said Vishvamitra.
notes: Renuka is the mother of Parashu Rama, another human incarnation of Vishnu as a Brahmin to struggle with the erring Kshatriya kings of an earlier era. Renuka's husband is Sage Jamadagni, the descendent of Bhrigu or also called as Bhaargava and on certain occasion, Jamadagi, orders his son Parashu Rama to behead her, i.e., Renuka, Parashu Rama's own mother and Parashu Rama unhesitatingly carries out his father's orders. Thus, Parashu Rama is called Bhaargava Rama, with an axe as his unsurpassed weapon. This Parashu Rama confronts Rama of Ramayana after Seetha's marriage.

glosses.meaning: oh, sage the best - oh, Shataananda
not, over, stepped - nothing left unperformed
Renuka, with [the descendent of] Bhaargava or Bhrugu, as with
wife [of sage,] with sage, is reunited.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः |
शतानन्दो महातेजा रामं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ |
śatānando mahātejā rāmam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing those words of that highly intellectual Vishvamitra, high refulgent sage Shataananda spoke these words to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव |
विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य महर्षिमपराजितम्
verses.iast:
svāgatam te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto asi rāghava |
viśvāmitram puraskṛtya maharṣim aparājitam
verses.translation: "Hail to thee! Oh, best one among men Rama, your arrival is a godsend, not only to Mithila but to entire humanity, and oh, Raghava, as an undefeatable great-sage Vishvamitra spearheads you, so shall your mission be undefeatable, thus hail to thee!
notes: This statement of Sage Shataananda shall remind us the utterances of Vishvamitra in Dasharatha's court at 1-19-14: aham vedmi mahātmānam rāmam... 'I know this great soul Rama, the virtue valiant, even Vashishta and also these saints who are here...' So also, Shataananda being the son of Ahalya and Gautama perceived who this Rama is. Further, when such and such a sage spearheads Rama, Rama ought to know something about the background of his steersman, namely Vishvamitra, basing on which Rama can learn his own lessons. As such, next few chapters are catered to the legend of Vishvamitra through Shataananda.

glosses.meaning: oh, best among men, oh, Raghava

verses.devanagari:
अचिन्त्यकर्मा तपसा ब्रह्मर्षिरमितप्रभः |
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वेत्स्येनं परमां गतिम्
verses.iast:
acintya karmā tapasā brahmarṣiḥ amita prabhaḥ |
viśvāmitro mahātejā - vedṃya - vetsi enam paramām gatim
verses.translation: "This highly resplendent Vishvamitra's exploits are unimaginable. He attained the highest order of Brahma-sage by his ascesis, thus illimitable is his ascetic resplendence, and you have to know him as an ultimate course, not only to you alone, but also to one and all.
notes: If the text 'you already know him...' is adopted there will be nothing left to Shataananda to say more. Hence, the meaning is said on taking vedmya 'you should know some more...' would be better. Because Vishvamitra is a parama hita sandhāyaka 'a do-gooder for universal peace' as indicated by his name itself, viśva 'of universe...' mitra 'friend, 'friend of universe...'

glosses.meaning: you have to know] vetsi = you [already] know.

verses.devanagari:
नास्ति धन्यतरो राम त्वत्तोऽन्यो भुवि कश्चन |
गोप्ता कुशिकपुत्रस्ते येन तप्तं महत्तपः
verses.iast:
na asti dhanyataro rāma tvatto anyo bhuvi kaścana |
goptā kuśika putraḥ te yena taptam mahat tapaḥ
verses.translation: "None other than you is fortunate enough on earth, oh, Rama, as you are in the custodial care of Vishvamitra, the scion of Kushika, who has practised supreme ascesis.

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि कौशिकस्य महात्मनः |
यथा बलं यथा तत्त्वं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु
verses.iast:
śrūyatām ca abhidhāsyāmi kauśikasya mahātmanaḥ |
yathā balam yathā tattvam tat me nigadataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: "What is the prowess of the great-souled Vishvamitra, and what the quintessence of his legend may be heard from me while I narrate it.

glosses.meaning: I will let you hear - hear from me
that, from me, while being narrated, you listen.

verses.devanagari:
राजाऽसीदेष धर्मात्मा दिर्घकालमरिंदमः |
धर्मज्ञः कृतविद्यश्च प्रजानां च हिते रतः
verses.iast:
rājā abhūt eṣa dharmātmā dīrgha kālam arindamaḥ |
dharmajñaḥ kṛta vidyaḥ ca prajānām ca hite rataḥ
verses.translation: "This probity-souled Vishvamitra, being a proficient in rectitude, a perfectionist in kingcraft, a proponent of people's welfare, more so a persecutor of enemies, was there as a king for a long time.

glosses.meaning: for people, also, in welfare, proponent of
for long, time, king, was there, he was.

verses.devanagari:
प्रजापतिसुतस्त्वासीत् कुशो नाम महीपतिः |
कुशस्य पुत्रो बलवान् कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः
verses.iast:
prajāpati sutaḥ tu āsīt kuśo nāma mahīpatiḥ |
kuśasya putro balavān kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: "There was a king named Kusha, a brainchild of Prjaapati, and Kusha's son was the powerful and verily righteous Kushanaabha.

verses.devanagari:
कुशनाभसुतस्त्वासीद्गाधिरित्येव विश्रुतः |
गाधेः पुत्रो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
verses.iast:
kuśanābha sutaḥ tu āsīt gādhiḥ iti eva viśrutaḥ |
gādheḥ putro mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: "One who is highly renowned by the name Gaadhi was the son of Kushanaabha, and Gaadhi's son is this great-saint of great resplendence, Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: Gaadhi, thus, only, verily heard [of highly renowned]

verses.devanagari:
विश्वमित्रो महातेजाः पालयामास मेदिनीम् |
बहुवर्षसहस्राणि राजा राज्यमकारयत्
verses.iast:
viśvamitro mahātejāḥ pālayāmāsa medinīm |
bahu varṣa sahasrāṇi rājā rājyam akārayat
verses.translation: "Vishvamitra ruled the earth, and this great-resplendent king ruled the kingdom for many thousands of years.

verses.devanagari:
कदाचित्तु महातेजा योजयित्वा वरूथिनीम् |
अक्षौहिणीपरिवृतः परिचक्राम मेदिनीम्
verses.iast:
kadācit tu mahātejā yojayitvā varūthinīm |
akṣauhiṇī parivṛtaḥ paricakrāma medinīm
verses.translation: "At one time the great-resplendent king Vishvamitra went round the earth marshalling a unit of akshauhini army.
notes: The army unit called akśauhini consists of 21,870 elephants, as many chariots, 65,610 cavalry, and 1,09,350 foot soldiers.

glosses.meaning: with Akshauhini unit of army, encircled by - along with

verses.devanagari:
नगराणि च राष्ट्रानि सरितश्च तथा गिरीन् |
आश्रमान् क्रमशो राजा विचरन्नाजगाम ह
वसिष्ठस्याश्रमपदं नानापुष्पलताद्रुमम् |
नानामृगगणाकीर्णं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्
देवदानवगन्धर्वैः किंनरैरुपशोभितम् |
प्रशान्तहरिणाकिर्णं द्विजसंघनिषेवितम्
ब्रह्मर्षिगणसंकीर्णं देवर्षिगणसेवितम् |
तपश्चरणसंसिद्धैरग्निकल्पैर्महात्मभिः
सततं संकुलं श्रीमद्ब्रह्मकल्पैर्महात्मभिः |
अब्भक्षैर्वायुभक्षैश्च शिर्णपर्णाशनैस्तथा
फलमूलाशनैर्दान्तैर्जितदोषैर्जितेन्द्रियैः - यद्वा -
फलमूलाशनैर्दानैर्जिततोषैर्जितेन्द्रियैः |
ऋषिभिर्वालखिल्यैश्च जपहोमपरायणैः
अन्यैर्वैखानसैश्चैव समन्तादुपशोभितम् |
verses.iast:
nagarāṇi ca rāṣṭrāni saritaḥ ca tathā girīn |
āśramān kramaśo rājā vicaran ājagāma ha
vasiṣṭhasya āśrama padam nānā puṣpa latā drumam |
nānā mṛga gaṇa ākīrṇam siddha cāraṇa sevitam
deva dānava gandharvaiḥ kinnaraiḥ upaśobhitam |
praśānta hariṇa ākīrṇam dvija saṅgha niṣevitam
brahma ṛṣi gaṇa saṅkīrṇam deva ṛṣi gaṇa sevitam |
tapaḥ caraṇa saṃsiddhaiḥ agni kalpaiḥ mahātmabhiḥ
satatam saṅkulam śrīmat brahma kalpaiḥ mahātmabhiḥ |
ab bhakṣaiḥ vāyu bhakṣaiḥ ca śīrṇa parṇa aśanaiḥ tathā
phalamūlāśanairdāntairjitadoṣairjitendriyaiḥ - yadvā -
phala mūla aśanaiḥ dāntaiḥ jita doṣaiḥ jita indriyaiḥ |
ṛṣibhiḥ vālakhilyaiḥ ca japa homa parāyaṇaiḥ
anyaiḥ vaikhānasaiḥ caiva samantāt upaśobhitam |
verses.translation: "Moving sequentially about the provinces, cities, rivers likewise mountains, king Vishvamitra arrived at the threshold of a hermitage which is with numerous flowered trees and climbers, overspread with very many herds of animals, adored by the celestials like siddha-s and caarana-s, frequented and embellished with gods, demons, gandharva-s, and kinnara-s, spread out with equable deer, adored by flights of birds, compacted with the assemblages of Brahma-sages, and also with the assemblages of godly-sages who are fully accomplished in their ascesis, where the personal resplendence of each of the great-souled sage is similar to each of the Ritual-fire available in each of the Ritual Fire Altar before which he is sitting, and which hermitage is bustling with the activity of great-souled sages who are comparable to Brahma, among whom some subsist on water alone, and some on air alone, likewise some more on dry leaves, while some on fruits, tubers, and with such of those sages and also with particular sages like Vaalakhilyaa-s, also with others like Vaikhaanasa-s, who are all self-controlled, who have overcame their peccabilites, who have overpowered their senses that hermitage is occupied, and while everyone of the inmates is engaged in meditations and oblations into Ritual-fire, and with such sages and their activity whole of the perimeter of that hermitage is brightened and rendered splendent, and king Vishvamitra arrived at such a magnificent hermitage of Sage Vashishta.

glosses.meaning: numerous, flowered, climbers, trees - which has
very many, animals, herds of, overspread - which is
gods, demons, gandharva-s, kinnaraa-s, [frequented and] embellished with
ascesis, practising, well, accomplished ones - with them
dried, leaves, eaters, likewise [some subsisting on them]
meditations, oblations in Ritual-fire, who are occupied with
well, up to end - whole of perimeter
magnificent one [to such a hermitage of]

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठस्याश्रमपदं ब्रह्मलोकमिवापरम् |
ददर्श जयतां श्रेष्ठो विश्वामित्रो महाबलम्
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭhasya āśrama padam brahma lokam iva aparam |
dadarśa jayatām śreṣṭha viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "And this best one among vanquishers and the great-stalwart Vishvamitra has then seen the hermitage of Vashishta which is like the worldly Universe of Brahma." Thus Sage Shataananda continued his narration.

glosses.meaning: not, other [not in other world, this worldly]
